items.quote: 31:12 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 31:13 Speak thou also unto the children of Israel, saying, Verily my sabbaths ye shall keep: for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations; that ye may know that I am the LORD that doth sanctify you.
items.claim: God commanded the Israelites to keep the Sabbath as an eternal sign of sanctification throughout generations
